description: Create, edit, analyze, and verify professional Excel workbooks with optional SandBase retrieval for requested external data.

requires: An authorized SandBase connection only for optional external data

install.prompt: Use $excel-generator to create and verify this Excel workbook.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill excel-generator --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill excel-generator --agent codex --global

examples: Create a multi-sheet operational dashboard from these CSV files.
Build an editable planning workbook with formulas, validations, and a summary chart.
Retrieve an approved external dataset through SandBase and document its freshness in the workbook.

optional_inputs: locale, currency, units, and target Excel version
required calculations, charts, and editable inputs
authorized SandBase connection for external data

notes: Workbook construction and formula authoring remain local.
SandBase is not used for data already supplied by the user.
Generated workbooks must be reopened and visually inspected when the host supports it.

endpoints.summary: Discover current external-data capabilities when retrieval is required.
Inspect live data coverage, schema, limits, and pricing.
Recover recent run status and observed cost.
Check balance before an approved retrieval batch.
